question1.question: Is the SVG to PNG converter completely free?
question1.answer: Yes! Our basic converter is completely free with no registration required. You can convert SVG code to PNG images instantly. Premium features like AI assistance and advanced templates require a subscription.

question2.question: What's the maximum file size I can convert?
question2.answer: Free users can convert SVG files up to 2MB. Premium subscribers enjoy unlimited file sizes and batch conversion capabilities for professional workflows.

question3.question: Do you support transparent backgrounds in PNG output?
question3.answer: Absolutely! Our converter preserves transparency from your SVG code, ensuring your PNG images maintain transparent backgrounds when needed.

question4.question: Can I edit SVG code directly in the tool?
question4.answer: Yes! Our built-in code editor features syntax highlighting, error detection, and real-time preview so you can modify SVG code and see changes instantly.

question5.question: How does the AI assistant help with SVG creation?
question5.answer: Our AI assistant can generate SVG code from text descriptions, optimize existing code for better performance, and suggest animations based on your design goals.
